 [REPLAY] Jonathan Lewinsohn – Diameter Capital Partners (Manager Meetings, EP.05) Feb 2, 2026

 On today’s manager meeting, Kristen VanGelder speaks with
Jonathan Lewinsohn. Kristen is Deputy Chief Investment Officer at
Evanston Capital, a $4 billion hedge fund of funds whose CEO and
CIO, Adam Blitz, was a past guest on the show. She’s spent the last
eighteen years at Evanston alongside Adam and the team. Jonathan
co-founded Diameter Capital four years ago alongside
Scott Goodwin and today manages a $6 billion credit-focused hedge
fund alongside $1 billion in CDOs and a $1 billion drawdown fund.
The two were colleagues at Anchorage Capital, and Jonathan spent
some time at Centerbridge Capital as well before
starting Diameter.

  

 Their conversation includes insights into the credit markets,
Diameter’s approach, and how it all comes together. Before we dive
in, Kristen and I discuss how Evanston came to back Diameter on day
one and how it fits into their portfolio.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
